{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "EC2ActionsOnResourcesInSpecificRegionsForCertainPrincipals",
      "Effect": "Deny",
      "Action": [
        "ec2:StartInstances",
        "ec2:CreateSecurityGroup",
        "ec2:DeleteTags",
        "rds:CreateDBInstance"
      ],
      "Resource": "*",
      "Condition": {
        "StringEquals": {
          "aws:RequestedRegion": ["us-east-1", "eu-west-1"]
        },
        "IpAddress": {
          "aws:SourceIp": "203.0.113.0/24"
        }
      },
      "Principal": {
        "AWS": [
          "arn:aws:iam::111222333444:user/david",
          "arn:aws:iam::555666777888:role/cross-account-role"
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "Sid": "KMSKeyPolicyStatements",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": [
        "kms:ListGrants",
        "kms:RevokeGrant"
      ],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:*:*:key/*",
      "Principal": {
        "AWS": "*"
      }
    },
    {
      "Sid": "AthenaQueriesAndWorkgroupsManagementByBobOrAdminRole",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": [
        "athena:GetQueryExecution",
        "athena:GetTableMetadata",
        "athena:BatchGetNamedQuery",
        "athena:ListWorkGroups",
        "athena:CreateWorkGroup",
        "athena:UpdateWorkGroup",
        "athena:DeleteWorkGroup",
        "athena:ListNamedQueries",
        "athena:CreateNamedQuery",
        "athena:UpdateNamedQuery",
        "athena:DeleteNamedQuery"
      ],
      "Resource": "*",
      "Principal": {
        "AWS": [
          "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/bob",
          "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/admin-role"
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "Sid": "DynamoDBCRUDOperationsAllowedToServiceRolesOnly",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": [
        "dynamodb:CreateTable",
        "dynamodb:DeleteItem",
        "dynamodb:GetItem",
        "dynamodb:PutItem",
        "dynamodb:Scan",
        "dynamodb:Query",
        "dynamodb:UpdateItem"
      ],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:dynamodb:*:*:table/*",
      "Principal": {
        "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/*-role"
      }
    },
    {
      "Sid": "LambdaFunctionsCreationDeniedUnauthorizedUsers",
      "Effect": "Deny",
      "Action": "lambda:CreateFunction",
      "Resource": "*",
      "Condition": {
        "StringLike": {
          "s3:ExistingObjectTag/Department": "Finance"
        }
      },
      "Principal": {
        "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::999888777666:user/unauthorized"
      }
    },
    {
      "Sid": "IAMPermissionsBoundaryAttachmentProhibited",
      "Effect": "Deny",
      "Action": "iam:AttachPermissionsBoundary",
      "Resource": "*",
      "Principal": {
        "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/service-role/*"
      }
    },
    {
      "Sid": "SQSPutMessagesWithSpecifiedConditionsAllowed",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": "sqs:ChangeMessageVisibility",
      "Resource": "arn:aws:sqs:*:*:queue*",
      "Condition": {
        "StringEquals": {
          "aws:RequestedRegion": "us-east-1"
        }
      },
      "Principal": {
        "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/alice"
      }
    },
    {
      "Sid": "GlueTablesDeletionControlViaPolicies",
      "Effect": "Deny",
      "Action": "glue:DeleteTable",
      "Resource": "arn:aws:glue:*:*:table/*",
      "Principal": {
        "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/bob"
      }
    },
    {
      "Sid": "CrossAccountTrustRelationshipsRestrictions",
      "Effect": "Deny",
      "Action": "iam:AddRoleToInstanceProfile",
      "Resource": "*",
      "Principal": {
        "AWS": "*"
      },
      "Condition": {
        "Bool": {
          "aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent": false
        }
      }
    },
    {
      "Sid": "CloudWatchLogsDeliveryControlsThroughPolicies",
      "Effect": "Deny",
      "Action": "logs:CreateExportTask",
      "Resource": "*",
      "Principal": {
        "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/cloudwatch-logs-delivery-role"
      },
      "Condition": {
        "StringNotEquals": {
          "aws:SourceVPC": "vpc-abcde012"
        }
      }
    },
    {
      "Sid": "EKSClusterModificationRestriction",
      "Effect": "Deny",
      "Action": [
        "eks:AssociateIdentityProviderConfig",
        "eks:CreateFargateProfile",
        "eks:DeleteFargateProfile",
        "eks:DisassociateIdentityProviderConfig",
        "eks:ModifyClusterConfig",
        "eks:UpdateNodegroupConfig",
        "eks:UpdateNodegroupVersion"
      ],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:eks:*:*:cluster/*",
      "Principal": {
        "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/restricted-role"
      }
    },
    {
      "Sid": "AWSServiceCatalogPortfolioSharePermissionControlled",
      "Effect": "Deny",
      "Action": "servicecatalog:CreatePortfolioShare",
      "Resource": "*",
      "Principal": {
        "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/portfolio-share-control-role"
      },
      "Condition": {
        "Bool": {
          "aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent": true
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}
